buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK 1.0 Removal of Safety Valves after making necessary scaffolding platform wherev er applicable. 2.0 Dismantling the valve. 3.0 Cleaning and servicing of valve internals thoroughly.

4.0 Inspection of valve internals and replacement of spares if warranted. 5.0 Lapping and blue matching for the valve seats in presence of NLCIL Engineers 6.0 Assembling of the valves. 7.0 In case of Safety Valves testing the valves at rated pressure in test bed and se tting the valves to set pressure. Arrangement of Test bed & required tools are in contractor scope. Both testing & pressure setting should be carried out in prese nce of NLCIL Engineers (Test Pressure will be different for different type SRVs. Minimum test pressure will be 1.5 KSC& Maximum test pressure will be 260 KS C). 8.0 After final inspection, painting the valves with high temperature resistance pai nt. 9.0 Fixing back the valves in the system. 10.0 Removal of scaffolding platform. 11.0 Attending to workmanship defects if any, during commissioning of the valves. 12.0 The Scope of Work mentioned is only indicative and not exhaustive. ***** 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS Part-I 1.0 In 2 X 250 MW TPS-II Expansion, Unit-II consists of 33 Nos. of safety relief valves. Work order will be awarded for on-site servicing of safety valves in the unit during unit overhauling/shutdown. 2.0 Necessary special tools, essential tools & tackles, Valves Test bed, all consumables, including Gada Cloth, Different type of Lapping paste, Nitrogen gas, high temperature resistance paint, and Welding rods of good make as recommended by NLCIL Engineer shall be strictly under contractor's scope. 3.0 Required man power for Removal, dismantling, cleaning, testing, assembly, painting and fixing the valves in the system is strictly under contractor's scope. 4.0 Scaffolding materials, Valve Spares, Electricity, Water, Gate passes for Men & Material will be provi ded by NLCIL. 5.0 Contractor’s representative has to report well in advance for preparation of Gate passes for their w orkmen along with their identity proof, police verification and ESI certificate. 6.0 Approval of NLCIL Engineers is final for work completion. 7.0 Accommodation is under contractor's scope. 8.0 Canteen facilities can be availed on chargeable basis in Thermal Plant premises during working hou rs. 9.0 Work Order will be placed on package basis only. Part-II 1.0 SUPERVISOR CHARGES – PENALTY CLAUSE Not Applicable 2.0 Tools & tackles, lifting machines & Safety appliances that are used for the work or by the workmen should posses ISI mark and valid test certificate from the competent authority. 3.0 The Contractor should observe all safety rules and regulations in force and ensure that all necessar y safety precautions are followed up strictly for the safety of workers engaged in the work. 4.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of t he NLCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. Any extra time / over time engagement of the man power shall be the contractor’s responsibility. 5.0 RATE OF WAGES The present rates of wages payable to various categories of contract workers and Supervisor are as below:

TABLE Wages to be paid Categor Dearness allowanc Total wages y Rate of wages e-(DA) w.e.f (Rs. per day) 01.10.2026 (Rs. per day) (Rs. per day) USK 350.00 215 565 SSK / Su 410.00 251 661 pervisor SK 494.00 300 794 HSK 579.00 354 933 6.0 RATE OF WAGES / DA PAYABLE TO THE WORKMEN The contractor has to pay the rates of wages / DA as per Table above as announ ced by NLCIL and any revision of rates of wages / DA from time to time. Howeve r, in case of any revision of rates of wages / DA notified during contract period, t he contractor shall pay the same along with P.F. & ESI component for the variou s categories of labour component. 7.0 RATE REVISION (NOT APPLICABLE). 8.0 CONTRACT WORKMEN DEATH RELIEF FUND (CWDF) 8.1 An amount equivalent to 0.2% (zero point two percent) of gross value of every bill payable (b efore statutory, non statutory deductions) shall be deducted towards “Contract Workmen Deat h Relief Fund” (CWDF) from the contractors for the works carried out by the contractor. No pro vision has been made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 8.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contract Workmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/- fr om every contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NL CIL from their salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be ma de from the bills of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & Form -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workman / S upervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / Unit Ac counts Centre. 9.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor s hall also produce the required age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 10.0 ESI & EPF The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of re mitting the contribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workman engaged by

them towards EPF (EPF & EDLI), ESI etc., (as applicable) and NLCIL as the princip al employer, will ensure compliance under the relevant applicable statutes by ve rifying the remittance made by the Contractor Employers before releasing part / final bills. 11.0 BONUS The contractor shall ensure payment of minimum bonus of 8.33% of the annual wages to the contract workmen engaged by them for more than 30 days subject to the wages ceiling as provided under Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 and failure i n this regard will be treated as violation of the terms of the contract. 12.0 SAFETY Personal protective equipments (PPE)ie like Helmet, Safety shoe, Goggles etc by to be provided by the contractor and it is in the scope of the contractor. 13.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Time is the essence of the contract. In case the contractor fails to complete the works within the stip ulated period (as mentioned in Cl. No. 16.2 of Part-II Special Conditions), then, unless such a failure is due to Force Majeure or due to Purchaser’s defaults, the total contract price shall be reduce d by ½% (half percent) of the total contract price per day of delay or part thereof subject to a maxim um of 5% of the total contract price, by way of reduction in price for delay and not as penalty. 14.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY General Guarantee for Warranty (GGW) for workmanship defect has to furnish fo r One month from the date of commissioning as per the NLCIL format at the tim e of work completion on stamp paper. 15.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable. 16.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT 16.1 Eleven (11) months from service start date as per GeM contract. Note: Lead days of 1 day are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offering service. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 1 day after contract genera tion date. 16.2 Period of Work: Servicing work has to be completed within 20 days from the date of unit handing over or line cl earance as intimated by NLCIL Engineers. 16.3 Date of Shutdown of unit will be intimated 7 days in advance; however, the contractor has to extend its full support to start the work in short notice also, if such Opportunity comes. 17.0 PAYMENT TERMS 17.1 Part payment will be made within 30 days from the date of submission of original invoice base d on the number of safety valves serviced. 17.2 The Final bill will be paid only after the finalisation of the contract. 18.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence. Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules.
19.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances. ***** . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file.
